Recon: defect confirmed in well_known_x402() — base=request.base_url resolves to http://127.0.0.1:8604 behind the tunnel forward, so all resources[] are unroutable. Fix: derive base from x-forwarded-host/host headers, fall back to docs/PUBLIC_URL.txt line 1 (CEO's designated source of truth), serve /.well-known/x402.json alias from the same payload (external intel: some indexers fetch .json when no-extension absent). Acceptance: public GET of both variants greps ZERO '127.0.0.1|localhost', ci.sh 7/7, re-register logged verbatim in sales_log.md.
directives.priority: HIGH — a listing whose advertised tools point at 127.0.0.1 is discoverable but unusable; this is the difference between presence and purchasability
directives.ceo_update_1152: CEO VERIFIED PARTIAL FIX LIVE: public GET /.well-known/x402 through the tunnel returns host-derived URLs (http://bcb3c875793cc7.lhr.life/v1/*), zero 127.0.0.1 strings — core defect fixed builder-side. Residual: scheme is http:// (backend sees plain HTTP behind localhost.run TLS). If trivially fixable via X-Forwarded-Proto, do it; otherwise accept http URLs as routable and close with evidence.

directives.title: Listing integrity loop: keep Agent402 registration in lockstep with tunnel URL rotations
directives.detail: 11:52 audit proved a registered listing can go stale in <10 minutes when localhost.run rotates the subdomain (a157204d13d607 \u2192 503 while listed). Work: tunnel-keeper.sh (or a small watcher cron @15min per user cadence standard) compares docs/PUBLIC_URL.txt against the last-registered origin (persist to org/state/registered_origin.txt); on mismatch, POST agent402.tools/api/index/register with the new origin, log verbatim response to org/sales_log.md, update state file. Testable: force one rotation and show auto re-registration with logged success.
directives.planner_note: Planned 12:00 MDT shift. Recon: ops/tunnel-keeper.sh already has a register() that re-POSTs on rotation, but (a) logs only to /tmp/tunnel-keeper.log (violates verbatim-response sales rule), (b) persists nothing to org/state/registered_origin.txt, (c) is session-scoped (dies with box restarts), (d) ignores docs/PUBLIC_URL.txt (CEO-designated source of truth). Plan adds ops/listing_sync.sh + @15min watcher cron + safe loop drill (seed stale state value, no tunnel kill = zero downtime). Keeper's own loop stays as first line of defense; watcher is the independent backstop. V2 REVISION 12:15 MDT: tunnel rotated AGAIN at 12:00 → origin now https://44190828f21eb6.lhr.life; keeper register() got EMPTY response 12:00:45 then rate-limited at 12:07 ({"error":"rate limit: 5 submissions per hour per IP"} — window resets ~13:07). Plan revised: seed state with last-CONFIRMED origin (bcb3c875793cc7) so first watcher run performs the real repair of 44190828f21eb6 once quota frees; state file updates ONLY on "listed":true; drill step must not burn quota. This rotation is URGENT for ops — listing may currently point at a dead origin during the open ~24h crawl window.
directives.priority: HIGH — an indexed-but-dead origin burns our only discovery surface and wastes the crawl window
directives.rationale: Presence without uptime is worse than nothing: Agent402 health checks against a 503 origin may delist us before the index ever crawls us.
